title: Stage 5.4 Amendment 4 Revised TS-5 Canonical-Center Projected-State EMA Smoke
unique_hypothesis: Feeding the canonical continuous center of TS-4's emitted integer placement back into the recursive EMA state removes the latent-state/output separation that is the preregistered mechanistic explanation for TS-4's acceleration shortfall, without changing the TS-4 projection, spatial objective, alpha, reset rules or any gate.

history.original_ts5_failure: RuntimeError: projected EMA state does not reproduce projected output at qvh_000194_9x16 frame 27
history.original_ts5_root_cause: adding the exact integer top-left projection correction to a continuous center state is not an inverse of the frozen floor/clamp placement map, so state feedback could not reproduce the emitted placement at clamp boundaries

method.name: projected_state_canonical_center_ema_v1
method.exact_semantics: Compute the ordinary continuous TS-1 EMA proposal. Place the frozen crop with the unchanged floor/clamp convention, apply the exact TS-4 discrete maximum-overlap projection P_t, emit that integer placement, and set the recursive state to its canonical continuous center C = (x + w/2, y + crop_h/2), where crop_h is the frozen internal integer crop height consumed by the placement map. The official evaluator-derived height h = w * target_h / target_w is emitted unchanged and is not a state variable.
method.state_verification: By construction place_crop_from_center(C(emitted)) reproduces the emitted integer top-left exactly, so a zero reconstruction residual is a mechanism invariant, not a tunable criterion.
method.fallback: Emit frozen TS-0 and clear state exactly as TS-4.

mechanism_checks: recursive state equals the canonical center of the emitted crop on every eligible frame (M1/M2)
the canonical state exactly reconstructs the emitted integer placement on every eligible frame (M3)
the EMA proposal recurs from the canonical previous state on every eligible transition (M1)
projected state placement is inside the exact TS-4 feasible set on every eligible frame
maximum-overlap objective is realized on every eligible frame
the canonical TS-4 projection operator reconstructs every revised projection
reset and fallback semantics equal TS-4
bbox visibility is pointwise equal to TS-4
invalid, NaN, OOB, and ratio violations are zero under the engineering validator
deterministic replay passes under the engineering validator

fields: acceleration by guard state and transitions
diagnostics.exact_geometry: Correction and state displacement use top-left L1 pixels. Feasible-boundary movement is the frame-to-frame L1 sum over safe_x_min, safe_x_max, safe_y_min, and safe_y_max. Acceleration keeps the canonical normalized crop-center definition.

promotion_rule.name: SMOKE_PASS_TO_FORMAL
after_failure: do not repair or rerun this Smoke

statistical_plan: Deterministic paired complete-set effect sizes on frozen Smoke24; exact unrounded comparisons; no p-values, tuning, optional exclusions, near-pass, or post-result threshold changes.
engineering_contract: Heldout and Official Test access zero
